summary: First-contact record written by Mandel from a read-only reading of the session transcript and repository on 2026-10-20; the adversarial re-check of the headline numbers did not run (session limit), so every figure is the child's own and unverified. Hurst (session_01Sxmv33Z3rkBy1wVC1KuN9D, branch claude/crypto-arbitrage-volatility-bot-qic8gv) built a Docker trading desk for a US retail account on Kalshi's CFTC-approved perpetuals, with a 75-entry pre-registration registry, selection-bias diagnostics (PSR/DSR, CSCV PBO, CPCV, MinTRL), executors for Kalshi, Coinbase Derivatives, Kraken and Alpaca, a Kelly-style allocator gated by deflated confidence, and daily collectors for data nobody sells (IBIT option surface, Kalshi perp books every 15 s, perp funding and trade tape, hourly hype signals, settled crypto binaries). It trades one rule live, armed with $1,000 since mid-October: short DOGE or SHIB after a one-day bounce inside a three-day decline, -20% target / +10% stop / 14 days, which backtests at +1.47%/trade over 938 trades on 18 memecoins (5/5 years positive) and +3.36%/trade over 123 trades on DOGE+SHIB at Kalshi's 18 bp round trip, but which its own diagnostics rate as not statistically credible after 4,512 searched trials (DSR 0.00 at nominal N, 0.18-0.35 at N_eff; MinTRL 32-104 months); it runs small, 'paying for execution data', with one paper signal per coin so far (Oct 9) and no real fill yet. Its October research sweep (30 addenda) found no new US-tradeable edge: Kalshi market making loses the 2 bp fee on 6.0 million trades, hourly rules on the perps earn under 6 bp gross against 16-18 bp of cost, 6,096 systematic rules deflate to nothing, Kalshi and Polymarket US agree within half a cent, funding on US venues averages about zero, weather markets out-forecast a free model, and the Bitcoin volatility premium is real (+5.3 vol points per trade at the gate, t 2.8) but its small-account form had a -88% month and the tamed ladder needs ~$25,000 of options margin. It reports the favourite-longshot bias on Kalshi crypto binaries at every horizon (longshots lose 27-72% per dollar; the daily BTC favourite pays +3.2% per dollar at t 1.8 on 52 days, under a 60-day forward test), a pre-registered QQQ opening-range breakout alive in backtest (+32.6%/yr, Sharpe 1.05, IEX bars, now in a 60-session paper pilot), and six forward tests with locked read dates from 2026-11-05 to 2027-10-01. It is unsure whether the live edge exists at all, names its own universe as hindsight-selected, and asks for weekly review output, a point-in-time coin universe, and years of track record before adding capital.
learnings: The bounce-short (short a one-day bounce inside a three-day decline on memecoin perps, -20%/+10%/14d) has a real but statistically uncredited edge; the edge is basket timing, not coin selection; expected live return should be shrunk hard toward zero. | evidence: Walk-forward 5/5 years positive on 18 coins (+1.47%/trade, 938 trades) and US-3 (+2.76%, 230); PSR 0.91-0.99; CSCV PBO 0.09-0.22; CPCV 5/5 paths; but DSR 0.00 at nominal N and 0.18-0.35 at N_eff after 4,512 trials; cross-sectional lift +0.002%; MinTRL 32-104 months (README 'How credible'; hypotheses.yaml perp-bounce-short, bounce-short-us3). Universe acknowledged as hindsight-selected (18 coins listed on Hyperliquid in 2026; all-176-perps version 3/5 years).

Quoting as a maker on Kalshi perps loses the 2 bp fee net of adverse selection on every liquid contract; resting favourite bids on Kalshi event contracts fill when they are wrong. | evidence: 6.0M trades: maker markout at 5 min net of fee BTC -2.0 bp (t -25), ETH -2.2 (t -54), gold -1.8 (t -12), silver -3.7 (t -11), DOGE -1.6 (t -1.1); resting favourite bids 15-min -11.0%/$ (t -2.7), hourly -3.1% (t -2.4) (RESEARCH addendum 29; hypotheses.yaml kalshi-perps-maker-taker, killed).
Taker order flow over 5 and 30 minutes predicts nothing on Kalshi perps worth trading. | evidence: |t| <= 2.5 on every perp; gold mildly contrarian at 0.4 bp per sd (addendum 29).

Hourly reversal, momentum and hour-of-day rules on Kalshi perps do not clear the 16-18 bp round trip; one-hour moves carry under 6 bp of predictable follow-through or reversal. | evidence: 26 rules on 20 perps, 45,419 hours; best gross +26 bp is the best of 26 (net +8 bp, t 0.9); walk-forward -45 bp/trade over 364 trades; family search on the same data N_eff 5, DSR 0.00, walk-forward -138% (addenda 17, 22).

Kalshi and Polymarket US price the same BTC contracts within half a cent on the slow ladders; no locked YES+NO edge survives two taker fees; fast-market gaps are a 30-second snapshot artefact. | evidence: 8,913 snapshots over 1.9 hours, 305 contracts; best locked edge -0.9c (daily) and -0.1c (weekly) (addendum 29; kalshi-polyus-crossvenue killed).

The favourite-longshot bias is present on Kalshi crypto binaries at every horizon: longshots lose 27-72% per dollar; the favourite pays after the fee only on the daily BTC contract (+3.2%/$ at 25% of life left, t 1.8 on 52 days) and not yet provably. | evidence: 20,640 settled markets (addendum 28); hourly KXBTCD 17,614 markets: favourite +0.63%/$ t 1.0, longshots -34%/-41% t -3.8/-5.0 (addendum 19); forward test registered, read 2026-12-13.

The Bitcoin volatility premium is real (DVOL exceeds subsequent realised vol by about 5 vol points at the gate, 2021-2026), but the one-straddle form a small account can run has catastrophic pin-gamma months, and only a 21-rung ladder (~$25,000 margin) tames it; the Kalshi hourly-binary form of the same risk is thin. | evidence: Addendum 15 table (gate >= 5: 56 trades, +5.3 vol pts, t 2.8, 6/6 years; one straddle worst month -88%, ladder worst -14.7%); addendum 19.

Funding carry is dead on US venues (funding averages about zero; a 14-day hedged hold at > 8%/yr funding nets -0.15%); Hyperliquid funding carry is 'alive' at +3.8 to +12.2%/yr on capital but closed to US users. | evidence: Addenda 21, 29; hypotheses.yaml carry-us (killed), kalshi-funding-carry-us (killed), funding-carry (alive, trials_run 54, diagnostics pending); ETF-hedged BTC carry forward test registered (read 2027-02-12).

A pre-registered 5-minute opening-range breakout on QQQ is alive: +32.6%/yr of capital at 1 c/share, Sharpe 1.05, PSR 1.00, 6 of 7 years. | evidence: 1,543 IEX sessions 2020-08..2026-10, mean +0.26 R/session, 20% hit rate, 1,239 stops / 65 targets / 239 flat (addendum 18; hypotheses.yaml orb-qqq-pilot); 60-session paper pilot running.

Calendar structure in crypto: no hour-of-day or weekday gives direction (the null's hit rate on 549 trials); weekends run 25-35% quieter; BTC's return accrues outside US equity hours but not reliably since 2024-11. | evidence: Addendum 25; hypotheses.yaml range-profile-2026-10, btc-offhours-seasonality (PSR 0.84; post-publication t 0.14).

Cross-asset leads: nothing in the US session leads BTC after the close (same-day comovement is already priced by 16:00); BTC's proxies' overnight move is beta not a lead; one macro lead candidate (2s10s slope change -> XLF, best of 48). | evidence: us-session-into-btc-afterhours 9 trials, QQQ -> BTC 16:00-20:00 t +1.2; crypto-proxy-crossref 43 trials; macro-relations 48 trials, 2s10s -> XLF t +2.6, 116 trades +109 bp (hypotheses.yaml).

Post-earnings drift in small caps is survivorship, not drift: the placebo entry 25 sessions after the report (+1.77%/month) beats the real entry (+1.32%/month). | evidence: hypotheses.yaml pead-per-price-smallcap (killed 2026-10-13), pead-revisit (-0.65%/month).

Kalshi's daily high-temperature markets already price day-ahead public forecasts; a free gridded forecast model loses 23% per dollar against the mid. | evidence: Brier model 0.144 vs mid 0.112 at 20:00 ET, 2,579 buckets; -23.3%/$ (t -4.7) (addendum 30).

Pre-registered forward tests, not yet read: BTC perp leads the US500 perp off-session (~Nov 5); order-book imbalance on 8 Kalshi perps (~Nov 12); daily BTC favourite (Dec 13); attention-spike fade on Kalshi coins (Jan 12); IBIT-hedged BTC funding carry (Feb 12); IBIT ladder out of sample (Oct 2027). | evidence: cryptobot/review.py FORWARD; hypotheses.yaml entries with 'PRE-REGISTERED ... not read before' and forward-read modules that refuse a verdict before the date (hype_forward.py, carry_forward.py).

questions: Whether the bounce-short's edge is real at all: 'the true number could be zero' (RESEARCH section 6); MinTRL 32-104 months; DSR 0.18-0.35.
Universe survivorship: 'the universe is chosen with hindsight ... the 18-coin numbers should be read as the optimistic end of the range' (README); DOGE/SHIB were selected because Kalshi lists them.

Whether the daily BTC favourite's +3.2%/$ is a lucky run: 'the first 29 days showed +4.6% at t 3.7, and 52 days show +3.2% at t 1.8. That shrinkage is what an early lucky run looks like' (addendum 28).

Whether the live bot's cutoffs match the replay: 'The live bot uses Kalshi and Coinbase prices, so its cutoffs can differ a little, and a borderline day could go the other way' (transcript 2026-10-20T00:10).

Coinbase's $0.20 per-contract fee floor: 'comes from Coinbase's blog and should be confirmed on the first real fill' (RESEARCH section 7); Kraken US perps contract size 'inferred from Bitnomial's product names, not confirmed' and API availability 'unconfirmed' (hypotheses.yaml kraken-us-perps-venue).

IBIT vs DVOL: the DVOL stand-in rests on 'the one shared day IBIT's own 30-day ATM implied vol sat 1.2 points under it' (addendum 15); the ladder is post hoc (DSR 0.59) and judged only after 12 months of IBIT rows.
Kalshi funding on metals and index perps rests on 6-32 days of prints: 'Re-read when the metal and index perps have months of prints, not weeks' (addendum 21).
ORB: the window 'is six years, not ten', 'IEX bars are a fraction of consolidated volume', and 'the replications say this is zero net on QQQ' (addendum 18; hypotheses.yaml).
The weekend-holding observation in btc-offhours-seasonality is 'Observation only, not a claim ... testing that is trial #2'.
The 2s10s -> XLF lead is 'best of 48 trials' and sits in a paper pilot for that reason.
Funding carry's 'alive' verdict has 'diagnostics pending' and the strategy is closed to US accounts.
Whether the Hyperliquid-based replay and the Kalshi-priced live book agree: the review command exists to find out, and no real trade has closed yet.
